title: The Last Girl
subtitle: A courageous, wonderful, and noble spirit. My sweet savior, my final girl.

items.text: A Nightmare at Green Lake

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Hmm. "The Last Girls" normally has two categories.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Anne is the exemplar of the first kind—pure, innocent, and mild, like a ...

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: The second kind is those cool girls, more condescending, erudite, and sophisticated.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: This category can easily tackle any difficulties and make sensible choices, like our Ms. Tooth Fairy.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: They are all good girls, approved by society. Therefore, people reward them the privilege to "survive."

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: The critter's claw and the butcher's cleaver will never hurt them or kill them!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So, what do you mean ...

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: I mean, please don't worry. Anne will be fine. She is safe.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: She is particularly safe, before we die.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: But if we lose her, the probability of our death will go up, up, up, up, up, and up.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Very comforting.
Behind the bushes, a tract of grass is flattened, as if something heavy was there.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wait. The carcass of the giant critter is missing.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Maybe it's not totally dead and has crawled back to its den? Hmmm.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It was dead. I've checked, and there was no way it could survive.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Here in the mud, it's the fur ... Oh also, what's this?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: A note? That's weird. Hey! Look! It's the butcher's footprints!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Let's follow up.
A mossy cave

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Hmm. The footprints disappear. The soil here is less moisturized than the outside, so the footprints are barely left.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This smell, I think I've smelled this before.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The key, this is the smell of the key.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The moss here is definitely special. We need to take some samples back for Ms. Tooth Fairy.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Vertin, is that you?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's Anne's voice. She must be here. Anne, can you hear me?

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: I'm here. I'm like ... below you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Below?
A hidden entrance greets Vertin as she splits and pushes the weeds and mosses aside. This is where Anne's voice comes out.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: The pit is deliberately dug. The soil here is dry and granular. This was originally a cave. She is hidden inside.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Horropedia rubs the soil with two fingers to take out the white moss inside and puts it in a sample bag.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see you.
Anne stands on her toes and tries hard to reach Vertin's hands.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Stay strong and take my hands. I will pull you out.
It's not a deep cave. As the girl up there pulls with full strength, the one down there gets out. They both fall to the ground.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: God, thank you. I thought I would die in there.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Where are the others? Are they alright? Did someone go rescue them as well?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We saved Blonney but didn't find any of the boys. Don't worry. We will do our utmost to find them.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: This is good news. Jennifer is safe now.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: The butcher threw me into that pit and left. I don't know when he'd be back. Perhaps anytime now …
Anne looks into the depths of the forest restlessly.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Vertin, we have to get out of here now!
The hunter is good at approaching his prey in silence.
The sound of heavy breathing suddenly comes from behind—like that in many other horror stories.
With the knife close to her neck, the girl can't help but tremble in fear.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Just as the classic plot goes, this is the right timing.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Step back. He can't kill you, but he might hurt you.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: No, I will fight along this time.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: I can't be a burden to you now.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Ahhh!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Run, run away from him. Don't let him catch you!

items.speaker: Butcher
items.text: Aah ...!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Anne!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Aaah ... ah …
Like a miracle, a branch strikes the knife forcefully. It bounces off the butcher's big hand and falls a few meters away.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: That is ...

items.speaker: Butcher
items.text: No ...

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: No, I won't allow it!
A scream squeezes its way out of the young girl's throat.
They start charging toward the knife at the same time.
Both of them stretch their arms and reach for the knife.
Anne reaches for the knife first, followed by the clumsy butcher.
In an instant, she jumps up and pins the butcher to the ground.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Aaaahhh!

items.speaker: Butcher
items.text: Aaarrrhh!
A gust of moist, hot air blows off like a stream.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Huuhh …
Sweat flows down her spine, despite the coldness at night.
The relief after the extreme tension makes the young girl shiver ceaselessly.
The towering body under her shrinks like a balloon, quickly losing its air and blending in with the soil.
A strong odor of beasts suddenly fills the air.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You can let go of me, Anne. It's over. He disappeared.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Oh, right. I know. I know.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yeah, you defeated him, like a marvelous miracle.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Wow! A miracle, the brave heart, and the miserable death of the crazy criminal killed by his own weapon.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: This is The Last Girl.
